name: Harghita – Covasna
summary: The Szekler Land is – in the historical-ethnographic sense – the region in the southeastern part of Transylvania, inhabited mostly by Szeklers, which includes the territories of the former Szekler seats. These territories are currently included administratively in the counties of Alba, Bacău, Cluj, Covasna, Harghita, Mureș, and Neamț. Colloquially, the name Szekler Land is understood to mean only the territory formed by the counties of Covasna, Harghita, and part of Mureș county.
